commenti.body: I just started watching Past Lives, and the framing seems to be so different, it has me glued and I dont want to turn it off.  Anyone feel/notice that?  Im not studied, is there a term for this type of cinematography?  Thanks.

My assignment is analyzing a 1200-word essay on a documentary that takes a stance on something whether it be (Climate Change, pollution, Vaccines, Bigfoot or the Yeti, Certain types of diets, Farming, Animal welfare, Gun Control, Big Oil or Big Pharma or Big Pesticide, etc.)  
I have to study the producers behind the documentary for credibility  
I have to study the "experts" for credibility  
I have to study some facts they give and I fact-check it to see if it is accurate  
I have to study some facts they give and I fact-check them to see if it is accuratericks, horrifying images, etc.  
I don't want to go the boring route and choose a well-made documentary where everything is fine and dandy. Can anyone suggest a documentary that's absolutely horrible and manipulative?
